query:
SELECT r.ZEXTERNALIDENTIFIER
        FROM ZREMCDREMINDER r
        WHERE lower(
          substr(hex(r.ZIDENTIFIER), 1, 8) || '-' ||
          substr(hex(r.ZIDENTIFIER), 9, 4) || '-' ||
          substr(hex(r.ZIDENTIFIER), 13, 4) || '-' ||
          substr(hex(r.ZIDENTIFIER), 17, 4) || '-' ||
          substr(hex(r.ZIDENTIFIER), 21, 12)
        ) = ?
